content.short: Rattle accelerates Web3 giveaways with on-chain fairness.
content.description: Rattle is a campaign platform built for giveaways, enabling the entire workflow—from application through the raffle—to run on-chain. This full-on-chain approach delivers transparent, verifiable participation for both collectors and creators and strengthens the overall integrity of every raffle. The system is designed for multi-network use, supporting Polygon, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Multichain, and Celo, so organizers can choose the best-fit chain while preserving a single, auditable process.
content.meta: Rattle is a campaign platform for giveaways with full on-chain transparency. Discover Rattle and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
